Check the menu regularly. It rotates. {{RANDOM | There's always something different from the last time you looked | Dishes change frequently, so what's on today might not be on next week | You'll find something new each time you check}}.

Reply

anytime. If you'd rather not visit the website, reply to any of our emails with Menu and we'll send you today's options and help you order directly.

variants.subject: A quick guide to making DabbahWala work for you
variants.body:
Four things that make a real difference.

Hi {{firstName|there}},

After your first order, here's what experienced DabbahWala customers tend to do:

1. Check the menu before deciding. It rotates — there's often something different. Visit https://www.dabbahwala.com or reply Menu and we'll send the day's options.

2. Order over $35. {{RANDOM | Delivery is free above that amount | That's the free delivery threshold | Orders above $35 include complimentary delivery}}.

3. Treat it like a regular thing, not a special occasion. The food is light enough to eat a few times a week — that's by design.

4. Consider a subscription if you find yourself ordering consistently. Meals arrive on your schedule without manual reordering.

Any questions — just reply. We respond quickly.

– DabbahWala Team

{{RANDOM | We rotate dishes regularly so that eating from the same kitchen doesn't start to feel like eating the same thing | We change the menu so that coming back always feels worth it | Repetition is the main reason people stop ordering from a service they liked — so we built in variety from the start}}.

Or reply Menu and we'll send you the current lineup.
